items.title: Lawrence Douglas Harris Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: when Booth came I had wrote an arrangement on Tiger Rag, well I insisted on him playing... We had no record on the music... Finally they got around to it... Well they played it

ctx.x: He said, man, I think it stinks. He said, no, that sounds good, you want some handle?
Well all right, when Booth came I had wrote an arrangement on Tiger Rag, well I insisted on him playing, let's play this Tiger. Tip

He said, yeah man, but let him play what he's been playing today on this thing. We had no record on the music. We said, oh man, we've got some stocks here we've got to run over. Finally they got around to it. He said, let him play it man. Well they played it, the guy said, yeah man, that thing is crazy. Well they all fell in and got the harmony and everything. Well they went back and got this arrangement, oh wait a minute, listen to what this chord is here. Well we used some of the same chords in this thing, in…
